contamination_test.statistic: flowcell concentration: sum over flowcells of (presences on flowcell)^2 / total presences

physalia_models.region_test: likelihood ratio versus model without ocean_region
physalia_models.fit_only_if_region_identifiable: at least 2 regions each represented on at least 2 flowcells, and flowcells spanning regions
physalia_models.community: Jaccard PERMANOVA on validated presence, ~ log10(input_pairs) + ocean_region, permutations restricted within flowcell

host_handling_subset.selection: seeded draw across input-depth quintiles among assembly-eligible libraries

capping_subset.selection: seeded draw among libraries above the 200 M-pair cap, spanning host routes

sensitivity.leave_one_study_out: count presences whose catalog genome was nominated only by a single study's libraries; no remapping
